Thanks for the heads up, Marissa. I will take ownership of the NDA review and coordinate counterparty engagement with Emily (their counsel) if needed. Initial guidance and timing:

- NDA: I can review ProspectCo's draft and propose redlines within 48 hours (target: 2026-02-26 end of day). For straightforward NDAs we usually return redlines quickly.
- Countersignature: Redwood prefers execution via DocuSign for speed; we can countersign once legal terms are agreed. If ProspectCo requires their version to be signed first, we can accept executed copies and countersign internally, but DocuSign is preferred.
- MSA / DPA sequencing: DPA language should be negotiated as part of the MSA for production. For the POC, include a short data handling appendix in the SOW and confirm sample data is redacted. If Kevin (security) requires a separate DPA at NDA stage, we can provide our standard DPA excerpt while MSA is in parallel.
- MSA turn times: expect 5-7 business days for our initial redline; extended negotiation can push that to 10+ days depending on indemnity/insurance requests. If underwriting/insurance is required, loop Finance.

Key negotiation points I'll watch for: IP ownership of derivative outputs, liability caps, data deletion/return obligations, and audit access. Please flag any specific redlines ProspectCo insists on.
